title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - relationship manifest schema
description: Schema for the relationship manifest provided with params.relationship_manifest. One row declares one exact oriented pair binding and its pairwise methods.

relationship_id.description: Unique identifier for the exact populated endpoint binding.
relationship_id.errorMessage: Relationship ID must be provided, must be unique and cannot contain spaces

left_analysis_id.description: Analysis identifier bound to the left endpoint for individual-level pair methods.
left_analysis_id.errorMessage: Left analysis ID cannot contain spaces

right_analysis_id.description: Analysis identifier bound to the right endpoint for individual-level pair methods.
right_analysis_id.errorMessage: Right analysis ID cannot contain spaces

left_summary_statistics_id.description: Summary-statistics identifier bound to the left endpoint for summary-level pair methods.
left_summary_statistics_id.errorMessage: Left summary-statistics ID cannot contain spaces

right_summary_statistics_id.description: Summary-statistics identifier bound to the right endpoint for summary-level pair methods.
right_summary_statistics_id.errorMessage: Right summary-statistics ID cannot contain spaces

relationship_methods.description: Comma-delimited supported pairwise methods selected for this relationship.
relationship_methods.errorMessage: Relationship methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

pair_quant_covariates.description: Optional headered file of relationship-owned quantitative covariates.
pair_quant_covariates.errorMessage: Pair quantitative covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

pair_cat_covariates.description: Optional headered file of relationship-owned categorical covariates.
pair_cat_covariates.errorMessage: Pair categorical covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist
